findings.message:
Parked incident can suppress an unrelated repository's incident

The parked-work lookup matches only `fingerprint`. A parked record from another repository or incident with the same fingerprint causes this `continue`, so the incoming summary is never persisted or turned into work. Match the record by incident identity and full repository scope before applying the parking guard.

src/repair/loop.ts:784-792

summary: The candidate parking guard is not scoped to the incident's repository or identity.
